item: President of the Tisztelet és Szabadság Párt (TISZA)
detail: Declared in section C of his European Parliament declaration (23 July 2024) and as an unpaid position in his Hungarian declarations of 2025–2026.
Declared as an unpaid association membership in his Hungarian declarations; the association is not named in the published form.

item: Trustee (kuratóriumi tag), Magyar Állami Operaház Balettnövendékeiért Alapítvány
detail: Foundation supporting ballet students of the Hungarian State Opera; declared as unpaid in his European Parliament and Hungarian declarations.

item: Declaration of awareness of conflicts of interest as Vice-Chair of the Committee on Constitutional Affairs (AFCO)
detail: Filed on 23 July 2024 on taking up the committee vice-chairmanship. His declaration of private interests lists no other interest that could influence the performance of his duties (section F empty).
